content: A cardiac rehabilitation program can assist you in several ways. It helps you understand the risk factors for heart disease and provides strategies to reduce them. It also focuses on improving your ability to manage stress, including anger management techniques. The program aims to lower your blood pressure and educates you on the mechanisms, effects, side effects, and potential drug interactions of your medications. Additionally, it works to strengthen your heart and cardiovascular system, enhance your overall sense of well-being and self-confidence, and improve your capacity for daily physical activities. When dining at a restaurant, there are specific dietary recommendations to follow. You should inquire about low-fat or fat-free options and request substitutions, such as steamed vegetables instead of French fries. Use the principles of your healthy eating plan to select a main dish, opting for lean meats, fish, or skinless chicken. Ensure that your entrée is prepared using healthier methods like broiling, baking, grilling, steaming, or poaching, rather than frying. Choose vegetable side dishes and ask for sauces or butter to be omitted. For salads, request low-calorie dressings or use lemon juice as a substitute. When ordering potatoes, prefer baked, boiled, or roasted options instead of fried, and ask for them without butter or sour cream. For dessert, select fresh fruit or fruit sorbet instead of cake, pie, or ice cream. If the menu seems restrictive, ask the chef to prepare a fruit or vegetable platter, as most chefs are willing to accommodate such requests. There are also specific items to avoid at restaurants. Push the butter aside or request its removal, and ask for soft margarine as an alternative. Order dressings and sauces on the side to control the amount you use. Avoid fried appetizers and creamy soups, and instead, start your meal with broth-based soups like minestrone or gazpacho. At salad bars, steer clear of high-fat items such as cheese, creamy dressings, chopped eggs, croutons, olives, and bacon bits. Request that your food be prepared without butter or cream-based sauces. When poultry is served, remove the skin, and trim visible fat from meats before eating.
